forecasts.title: Control of the U.S. Senate, 2026
forecasts.question: Which party will control the U.S. Senate after the 2026 midterms?
forecasts.dek: Republicans are favored to keep the Senate — about 58% once the hold sub-paths are summed — because the 2026 map makes Democrats net four seats while defending Georgia and Michigan. The modal path is a narrow GOP hold as the map absorbs a strong Democratic wind.

forecasts.title: Control of the U.S. House, 2026
forecasts.question: Which party will control the U.S. House after the 2026 midterms?
forecasts.dek: Democrats are ~83% to win the House on the deepest markets — the president's party has lost seats in 20 of the last 23 midterms — but a Republican-tilted map makes the modal path a narrow-to-moderate flip, not a wave.

forecasts.title: Georgia U.S. Senate — Ossoff vs. Collins
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 Georgia U.S. Senate race — Ossoff or Collins?
forecasts.dek: Democratic incumbent Jon Ossoff is favored near 78%, but Georgia's six straight sub-three-point top-of-ballot finishes mean the summer lead is built to compress. Mike Collins is the live underdog.

forecasts.title: North Carolina U.S. Senate — Cooper vs. Whatley
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 North Carolina U.S. Senate race — Cooper or Whatley?
forecasts.dek: The open Tillis seat is Democrats' clearest pickup: former governor Roy Cooper leads RNC chair Michael Whatley and is priced near 78% once the thin market is discounted for a summer lead four months out.

forecasts.title: Maine U.S. Senate — Collins vs. Platner
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 Maine U.S. Senate race — Collins or Platner?
forecasts.dek: The one true toss-up of the five. The markets tilt to Democrat Graham Platner (~57%) on Maine's blue lean, but head-to-head polls are a dead heat and Susan Collins has outrun her state before.

forecasts.title: Brazil or Norway — World Cup Round of 16
forecasts.question: Will Brazil advance past Norway in the 2026 World Cup Round of 16?
forecasts.dek: Brazil to reach the quarterfinal at 62–68%, held at the exact-question 'to advance' market — a strong lean, not a lock, with the Haaland-and-hoodoo Norway case the live dissent; the seven standing profiles split 5–2.

forecasts.title: Who Wins Wimbledon 2026 — Women
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 Wimbledon Ladies' Singles title?
forecasts.dek: Aryna Sabalenka is the single most likely name at 25–30%, held right at her exact-question price — but a champion is collectively likelier to come from the field, the honest runner-up at 22–30%; the seven standing profiles split 5–1–1.

forecasts.title: Who Wins Wimbledon 2026 — Men
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 Wimbledon Gentlemen's Singles title?
forecasts.dek: Jannik Sinner defends at 53–59% — a live No. 1 and defending champion at the most seed-friendly major, with Alcaraz withdrawn; a bottom-half challenger is the runner-up at 16–22% and the Prophet backs a fated Djokovic 25th. The seven standing profiles split 3–2–2.

forecasts.title: Who Wins the 2026 US Open — Men
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 US Open Men's Singles title?
forecasts.dek: Jannik Sinner is favored at 48–55% off a 44-3 season and a fifth major at Wimbledon, but Carlos Alcaraz — last year's champion here, reportedly fully healed from his wrist injury and returning at Cincinnati in August — is the live runner-up at 18–24%; the seven standing profiles split 4–2–1.

forecasts.title: Who Wins the 2026 US Open — Women
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 US Open Women's Singles title?
forecasts.dek: Aryna Sabalenka is favored at 28–33% to become the first three-peat US Open champion since Serena Williams, riding a 23-1 hard-court season; Iga Swiatek is the runner-up at 15–19%, with Elena Rybakina — the one player who beat Sabalenka in a 2026 major final — the live dissent pick. The seven standing profiles split 4–1–2.

forecasts.title: Will the Astros Make the 2026 MLB Playoffs
forecasts.question: Will the Houston Astros make the 2026 MLB playoffs?
forecasts.dek: Houston sits 55-55, half a game out of the last AL Wild Card spot in one of the tightest five-team bubbles in baseball, but sportsbooks price them at only 28–34% to make it (66–72% NO) — the standings look like a coin flip, the market says the underlying roster isn't. The seven standing profiles split 5–2 toward NO.

forecasts.title: Who Wins the 2028 US Presidential Election
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2028 US presidential election?
forecasts.dek: Democrats are the favorite to retake the White House at 52–58% — a weak favorite over a market-priced ~45% Republican hold, with the person race wide open (Vance the modal Republican, Newsom the modal Democrat); the six standing profiles split 4–2.

forecasts.title: Who Will Win the 2026 World Cup
forecasts.question: Who will win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?
forecasts.dek: Six standing predictor profiles each committed to one champion; the council's consensus pick is France at 28–32%, with the Historian's Argentina dissent preserved.

forecasts.title: The Iran War Through 2028
forecasts.question: How does the Iran war resolve — settlement, another round, frozen standoff, regime change, or the bomb?
forecasts.dek: Five priced scenarios for the US–Israel–Iran confrontation: a funded settlement is the favorite at 31–41%, with a third war round overlapping at 27–37% — the six standing profiles split 3–2–1.

forecasts.title: LeBron's Next Team, 2026-27
forecasts.question: Which NBA team will LeBron James play for during the 2026-27 regular season?
forecasts.dek: Seven standing predictor profiles each committed to one team; the consensus is a Cleveland homecoming at 36–44%, with the Warriors' clean-money case the live dissent at 24–31%.

forecasts.title: Google Ad-Tech Remedy: Breakup or Behavioral?
forecasts.question: Will the remedies ruling in US v. Google (ad-tech antitrust) order a structural divestiture of Google's ad-tech assets (AdX and/or DFP), rather than behavioral-only remedies?
forecasts.dek: Four priced outcomes for Judge Brinkema's ad-tech remedy: a forced AdX-only divestiture is the narrow favorite at 33–42% (YES), essentially tied with a hard conduct-only order at 34–42% (NO) — the seven profiles split 4 YES / 3 NO, the Prophet alone on a full AdX+DFP breakup.

forecasts.title: TikTok US Divestiture: Does the Deal Hold?
forecasts.question: Will the January-2026 US TikTok joint venture stand and be treated as a qualified divestiture under the divest-or-ban law, rather than being ruled not-qualified or judicially unwound back to ByteDance control?
forecasts.dek: The January-2026 US TikTok joint venture most likely stands as a qualified divestiture at 66–76%, with a 'survives under legal cloud' runner-up at 13–19%; the desk splits 5 YES / 2 NO, the Prophet holding out for a judicial unwind.

forecasts.title: Netflix's Ad Tier: Milestone or Still Building?
forecasts.question: Will Netflix, by its Q4 2026 report (~Jan 2027), disclose its ad-supported tier crossing a stated scale/ad-revenue milestone or confirm completion of its in-house Ads Suite cutover — rather than no in-window milestone being cleared under a strict read?
forecasts.dek: Netflix most likely discloses an ad-tier milestone by its Q4 2026 report at 60–70% (YES), with a strict-reading 'doesn't cleanly count' NO at 17–25%; the desk splits 5–2, the risk being definitional, not business.

forecasts.title: FY2027 Funding Fight: Does the Government Shut Down?
forecasts.question: When the FY2027 appropriations/continuing-resolution fight comes to a head around September 30, 2026, does the federal government suffer a funding lapse (shutdown), or is one averted by a CR or deal?
forecasts.dek: A near three-way split: a CR or deal narrowly leads at 42–52%, with an extended shutdown running neck-and-neck at 18–26% given this Congress already logged two funding lapses this fiscal year — the desk splits 3 averted / 3 extended / 1 brief.
forecasts.pick: CR or deal averts a lapse (NO SHUTDOWN)

forecasts.title: The Fed's September Verdict: Hold, Cut, or Hike?
forecasts.question: What does the Federal Reserve do to its target interest rate at the September 16, 2026 FOMC meeting — hold, cut, or hike?
forecasts.dek: The live story flips the assumed question: a 25bp hike narrowly leads at 45–55%, not a cut, as oil above $100/bbl and hawkish new Chair Kevin Warsh push against a bare 35–45% hold — the desk splits 5 hike / 2 hold, a cut all but priced out at 3–8%.

forecasts.title: Michigan U.S. Senate — Abdul El-Sayed vs. Mike Rogers
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 Michigan U.S. Senate race?
forecasts.dek: Democratic primary favorite Abdul El-Sayed is favored in the general near 52-60%, but his own matchup polling against Mike Rogers runs measurably weaker than rival Haley Stevens’s — a real Republican path stays open in this open-seat race.

forecasts.title: New Hampshire U.S. Senate — Pappas vs. Sununu
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 New Hampshire U.S. Senate race?
forecasts.dek: Chris Pappas is favored for the open seat near 70-78%, backed by a 2:1 cash edge and a collapsing Trump approval — but a tightening polling trend keeps John Sununu’s comeback bid live.

forecasts.title: Texas U.S. Senate — Paxton vs. Talarico
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 Texas U.S. Senate race?
forecasts.dek: Ken Paxton is favored near 52-60% on Texas’s three-decade Democratic statewide drought, but two deep markets disagree with each other and James Talarico’s historic fundraising edge keeps a genuine upset path alive.

forecasts.title: Georgia Governor — Bottoms vs. Jackson
forecasts.question: Who wins the 2026 Georgia governor's race?
forecasts.dek: Keisha Lance Bottoms is favored near 53-61% for the open seat after Republican Rick Jackson declined a debate, but his still-unspent $87M ad blitz and a near-tied June poll keep the race live.

forecasts.title: The 2026 Generic Congressional Ballot Margin
forecasts.question: What will the national House popular-vote margin be in 2026?
forecasts.dek: A Democratic-leaning national House result of four to ten points is the modal call, anchored on a real prediction market and the current polling average — with a genuine wave scenario and a compression toward toss-up both kept live.
